1  HON'BLE VIKRAM D. CHAUHAN, J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.

2. This application has been filed by applicants for quashing the summoning order dated 21.11.2024 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Agra in Case No.22308 of 2024, State (FSO) Vs.
Somdatt Sharma and others, under Section 26, 51, 59 of Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Act, 2006, Police Station Sikandra, District Agra.
3.

sentences.text: After some argument, learned counsel for the applicants prays that applicants may be permitted to move appropriate application before the Court concerned as provided under Section 250(2) of BNSS.
4. Learned A.G.A. for the State has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants.
5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants are permitted to appear before the concerned court within 15 days from today and move an application claiming discharge.
The concerned court shall after hearing the counsel decide the application on merits, in accordance with law expeditiously.
6. For a period of 30 days, no coercive action will be taken against the applicants.

7. With the above observations, this application stands disposed of.
(Vikram D. Chauhan,J.) October 9, 2025 Bhaskar  Somdat Sharma And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111756692/
